# Raze device configuration (device package "raze", contract 1).
#
# The OS config.txt pulls this in at top level (under [all]) with:
#
#   include raze-device.txt
#
# Everything here is a default. To change an overlay's parameters, or to drop a
# line, copy the lines you want into your own config.txt instead of including
# this file.

[cm5]
# >>> gen-raze: i2c (generated from manifest.json by devices/tools/gen-raze.py; do not edit)
# Hardware I2C bus 1 (/dev/i2c-1): SDA GPIO10, SCL GPIO11; BMM150, INA238.
dtoverlay=i2c1-pi5,pins_10_11
# No overlay for GPIO8 SDA / GPIO7 SCL (BMI088): lemnosd runs
# that bus on RP1 PIO (pio-i2c), so nothing else may claim the pins.
# <<< gen-raze

# >>> gen-raze: leds (generated from manifest.json by devices/tools/gen-raze.py; do not edit)
# Status LED ring: 16 SK6812-EC20 LEDs (24-bit GRB on the wire)
# on GPIO13 via RP1 PIO, /dev/leds0. No `rgbw`: that sends 32 bits per LED and
# smears the colours around the ring.
dtoverlay=ws2812-pio,gpio=13,num_leds=16,brightness=255,dev_name=leds%d
# <<< gen-raze

# External USB-A and USB-C port power, held on by the kernel.
dtoverlay=raze-usb-power

# Fan, driven by the kernel thermal governor.
dtoverlay=raze-fan

# GPU (V3D) and display (KMS) drivers.
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d-pi5

# Kernel logs kept in RAM across a reset (pstore, ramoops): 256 KiB at
# 0x0b000000, 128 KiB of it the console log (what the kernel printed until
# the reset) and two 64 KiB panic/oops records. A warm reset (the watchdog,
# a reboot) keeps them; a power loss doesn't. board-pstore.service moves them
# to /data/board/pstore/ on the next boot.
dtoverlay=ramoops-pi5,total-size=0x40000,record-size=0x10000,console-size=0x20000

# CM5 USB 2.0 OTG controller (dwc2) as a USB peripheral, for the USB gadget
# (network + serial). Which Raze connector it is wired to is not recorded yet.
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=peripheral

# >>> gen-raze: camera (generated from manifest.json by devices/tools/gen-raze.py; do not edit)
# OV9782 global-shutter camera on CAM0, continuous clock.
camera_auto_detect=0
dtoverlay=ov9782,cam0,clk-continuous
# <<< gen-raze

[all]

# Hardware watchdog available to the kernel from the start. systemd arms it
# (RuntimeWatchdogSec, package system.conf.d) once PID 1 runs; a panic before
# that restarts through panic= on the OS's cmdline (docs/ota.md).
dtparam=watchdog=on
